title: What If the Moon Vanished Right Now?
description: The Moon looks peaceful in the night sky, but it is secretly holding Earth's entire climate together. If it vanished tonight, hyper-winds, collapsed tides, and extreme seasons would reshape our planet forever. Could humanity survive a six-hour day—tell us in the comments! #Shorts #Space #Science #Moon #Astrophysics
